reviewMethod: source-based assistant review; not independent human or blinded validation

qualityDefinitions.taskCompletion: All frozen task success criteria met; source delivery alone is insufficient.
qualityDefinitions.factualSupport: Material claims are supported by delivered original evidence; unavailable on refusal.
qualityDefinitions.citationAccuracy: Citations identify the supporting original file and region; unavailable without a claim.
qualityDefinitions.sourceRelationships: Requested table grid/blankness and complete-section order/coverage verified from original source and delivered evidence; no pass inferred from unordered text matches or metadata.

meaning: bounded functional baseline; no ANN, strategy, provider or latency/cost winner

sourceDelivery.meaning: single-body normalized-text match only; false can mean text split across delivered bodies, not source loss; true does not verify source order, snapshot, relevance or complete section coverage
